-- Shopping cart helpers.
--
-- Carts are plain tables: { items = { {sku=..., price=..., qty=...} }, discount = 0 }.

local M = {}

local RATES = { PL = 0.23, DE = 0.19, US = 0.0 }

--- Creates an empty cart for a country.
function M.new(country)
  return { items = {}, discount = 0, country = country or "PL" }
end

--- Adds an item; a second add of the same sku bumps the quantity.
function M.add(cart, sku, price, qty)
  qty = qty or 1
  for _, line in ipairs(cart.items) do
    if line.sku == sku then
      line.qty = line.qty + qty
      return cart
    end
  end
  table.insert(cart.items, { sku = sku, price = price, qty = qty })
  return cart
end

function M.remove(cart, sku)
  for i, line in ipairs(cart.items) do
    if line.sku == sku then
      table.remove(cart.items, i)
      break
    end
  end
  return cart
end

--- Sum of line totals before discount and tax.
function M.subtotal(cart)
  local sum = 0
  for _, line in ipairs(cart.items) do
    sum = sum + line.price * line.qty
  end
  return sum
end

function M.total(cart)
  local base = M.subtotal(cart) - cart.discount
  if base < 0 then
    base = 0
  end
  local rate = RATES[cart.country] or 0.0
  return math.floor(base * (1 + rate) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

local function trim(s)
  return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

function M.coupon(cart, code)
  code = trim(code)
  if code == "HALF" then
    cart.discount = M.subtotal(cart) // 2
  elseif code:match("^FIX%d+$") then
    cart.discount = math.min(tonumber(code:sub(4)), M.subtotal(cart))
  end
  return cart
end

return M
